# Endpoints this repository needs beyond the organisation allow-list.
# The release workflow's build and publish-chart jobs read this file,
# at the tagged commit, through harden-runner-block-action's
# supplemental_config. The test workflow's release-build job reads it
# at a pull request's head commit, so a change here is tested with it.
# The scheduled plugin lock check reads it at the default branch.
# The Linting workflow reads it at the commit it lints.

# Plugin catalogue artefacts pinned in docker/plugins.lock, fetched
# only when the lock has no GHCR mirror yet
gerrit-ci.gerritforge.com:443
# Blob downloads from the GHCR plugin catalogue mirror redirect here
pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com:443
# Helm release archives that azure/setup-helm downloads
get.helm.sh:443
# Go release metadata and archives prek fetches to build the
# actionlint-shellcheck hook in the Linting workflow; the archive
# download redirects to dl.google.com, on the organisation list
go.dev:443
